activity.notes: Rajendra Chola I was formally associated with his father Rajaraja I in royal government from 1012 and ruled as co-regent until Rajaraja's death in 1014, when Rajendra became sole emperor. ATLAS records the 1012-1014 joint rule separately from the existing 1014-1044 sole imperial reign.

sources.title: Rajendra Chola I (1012–1044 CE) in South India — Indian Historical Review
sources.citation_text: The peer-reviewed Indian Historical Review study dates Rajendra Chola I's reign from 1012 to 1044, overlapping Rajaraja I's final years before Rajendra's sole accession.

sources.title: South Indian Inscriptions, Volume III — introduction
sources.citation_text: The published South Indian Inscriptions introduction states that Rajendra's reign commenced in 1012 and that during the first three years he ruled as co-regent with his father.
